test_title: PYST 25: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A $ B means 'A is the son of B'

A + B means 'A is the brother of B'

A@B means 'A is the wife of B'

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'

Based on the above, how is E related to N if 'E $ F @ G ÷ M + N'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 $
 +
 @
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given:E $ F@G÷ M + N

It means: E is the son of F, F is the wife of G, G is the father of M, M is the brother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ae76a386174d873293d386b24d6847f6a3a5c30c200c15e3e5ee5fbf53e2a5f.png] 

So, E is the 'brother' of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
